videos.title: Boogie Frights / Abracadaver
videos.overview: The heinous Him toys with Bubbles' mind by speaking to her through Octi, her favorite stuffed animal. Following Octi/Him's instructions, Bubbles provokes a fight between her sisters that prompts the Professor to issue a time-out until the Girls can make amends and make squid-meat out of the giant, Him-controlled Octi.
